description: Aeronautics - Airports is a dataset listed in State of Delaware open data portal (data.delaware.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Delaware. The geographic locations were determined using the Airport Reference Points for each airport as reported on their respective Master Records. These records were accessed using a database from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). Coverage: Delaware. The table has 12 columns. The portal shows 2021-08-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-delaware-gov-portal.
